_doc: Size overrides for library aliases of simHeaven paths; read by build_library_overrides.py.
A (region, path) is overridden when any target-pack export of it draws a mesh at least
max_area_ratio times the area its name gives (house_09x08x1 = 9 m x 8 m).
Replacement: simHeaven's own mesh for that region where one fits, else the largest
building mesh from the source packs that fits inside the named footprint (the region's
own style wins while it covers same_style_within of the best fit's area); failing that,
the mesh overshooting the named sides least, up to closest_max_overshoot.
manual entries win over both: mesh = '<pack folder>/<path in pack>' (a list for several
variants), or mesh = 'keep' to leave the target pack's exports alone; region omitted =
every region the path is overridden in.
